integrity.claim_scope: One exact rational generating function, minimal recurrence and sharp asymptotic error for a natural arithmetic counting invariant.
integrity.mathematical_proof: Exact eight-state polynomial identity plus elementary spectral and Cesaro arguments; reproducibility code checks the finite certificate.

scientific_limitations: Modulus seven and dyadic prefixes only; no formula for all nonzero residues or arbitrary intervals. The modulus-seven limiting density and general finite-state method are established prior work. A cited 2012 course manuscript could not be fully inspected, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact dyadic Stern-zero counts modulo seven and a sharp square-root discrepancy
